annotations.title: Writers whose prose and ideas sit closest to a given writer

description: For 'who writes like X', 'which authors sound like X', 'who is closest to X in style / in ideas'. Over 77 writers from Homer to Joyce: nearest by distinctive vocabulary (TF-IDF) and nearest by ideas and imagery (embeddings), plus the writer's prose circle. For Cormac McCarthy, Herman Melville and William Shakespeare it adds the character-GPT cross-reading: a small GPT trained on each one reading the others (bits per character), each author's word tells, and which book a model's generated text lands nearest.

limit.description: How many nearest writers per measure (default 8)
